complete_available_job_description:
We Are:
At Ansys, Part of Synopsys, we’re the global leader in engineering simulation software, helping innovative companies solve complex design challenges. Our cutting-edge solutions power advancements across industries, from aerospace to consumer electronics. Join us and help shape the future of technology.
You Are:
You are a highly motivated engineer who thrives at the intersection of engineering simulation, data-driven methods, and AI/ML-enabled workflows. Your expertise allows you to operate confidently in customer-facing environments, translating complex, multidisciplinary challenges into scalable, practical solutions. You possess a strong foundation in simulation or engineering systems, hands-on experience with machine learning and automation, and the ability to engage as a trusted technical advisor.
You are energized by ambiguity, seeking out opportunities to enable new ways of working through automation, digital twins, and intelligent simulation workflows. You are passionate about democratizing simulation technology, making advanced capabilities accessible to a broader spectrum of users. Your approach is both strategic and hands-on, balancing high-level vision with detailed technical execution.
You excel in collaborative environments, working closely with cross-functional teams and customers to deliver impactful solutions. You advocate for innovation and continuous improvement, mentoring peers and championing best practices. Your communication skills enable you to distill complex concepts into actionable insights, fostering understanding across diverse audiences. Above all, you are driven by the desire to make a tangible impact in the world of engineering and technology.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Lead and execute technical engagements across the customer lifecycle, including discovery, solution development, demonstrations, evaluations, and deployment.
Engage directly with customers to understand engineering workflows, data availability, and decision-making processes, translating them into AI-enabled simulation and digital engineering solutions.
Develop and implement differentiated solutions using technologies such as automation, reduced order modeling, optimization, simulation democratization, system-level modeling, and digital twins.
Integrate machine learning models within simulation and digital twin pipelines to improve prediction accuracy, reduce computational cost, and enable near real-time insights.
Define and deliver automated and scalable workflows that reduce reliance on expert-driven simulation and enable broader adoption across engineering teams.
Lead or contribute to first-of-a-kind or ambiguous use cases, including AI-assisted design exploration, surrogate modeling, and digital twin deployment.
Collaborate closely with product development teams to influence roadmap,validatenew capabilities, and improveusabilityof AI-enabled features.
Deliver professional services, training, and technical guidance to ensure successful adoption of advanced workflows.
Support pre-sales and technical marketing activities through demonstrations, evaluations, and industry engagement.
Mentor team members and contribute to the best internal practices around AI, automation, and simulation integration.
The Impact You Will Have:
Enable customers to transition from traditional simulation to AI-augmented and automated engineering workflows.
Reduce time-to-insight through surrogate modeling, optimization, and intelligent automation.
Expand access to simulation by supporting democratization across engineering and non-expert users.
Drive adoption of digital twin technologies for predictive and operational decision-making.
Influence product direction by connecting real-world use cases with next-generation AI-enabled capabilities.
Contribute to business growth through high-impact technical engagements and solution delivery.
What You’ll Need:
MS (or PhD) in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or relatedfield.
5+ years of experience in engineering systems, simulation, or data-driven modeling.
Strong programming skills (Python preferred).
Experience working with modeling, simulation, optimization, or data-driven engineering workflows.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability tooperateeffectively in a customer-facing, consultative engineering role.
Proven experience in automation of engineering workflows or pipelines using tools such asoptiSLang,modeFrontier, HEEDS or equivalent.
Demonstratedexpertiseapplying machine learning techniques in engineering contexts, including surrogate modeling, regression methods, or neural networks (CNNs, RNNs, autoencoders).
Understanding ofprojection-based ROMs, dimensionality reduction, and feature engineering.
Knowledge of multi-fidelity system modeling using Twin Builder, Simulink,AMESimor equivalent.
Familiarity with deployment and operationalization of AI models, including integration into engineering workflows and use of frameworks such asPyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure equivalent.
Exposure tocloud or HPC-based environments for large-scale simulation or data processing.
Who You Are:
Customer-focused and able to build trusted relationships.
Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-evolving technical environments.
A strong communicator who can translate complex concepts into actionable insights.
Self-driven, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
A collaborative team player who contributes to a culture of learning and innovation.
The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
You will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team focused on advancing industry adoption of simulation through AI, automation, digital twin, and MBSE technologies. The team collaborates closely with customers, product development, and go-to-market functions to deliver innovative, high-impact solutions.
Rewards and Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

source_jobposting_metadata.title: Staff Engineer – AI/ML & Digital Twin

required_qualifications: MS or PhD in engineering, computer science, applied mathematics or related field.
At least five years in engineering systems, simulation or data-driven modeling.
Strong programming; Python preferred; modeling/simulation/optimization workflow experience.
Analytical, problem-solving, communication and consultative customer-facing capability.
Proven engineering workflow automation with optiSLang, modeFrontier, HEEDS or equivalent.
Applied engineering machine learning; surrogate/regression/neural-network experience.
Projection-based reduced-order models, dimensionality reduction and feature engineering.
Multi-fidelity system modeling with Twin Builder, Simulink, AMESim or equivalent.
Familiarity with deploying AI into engineering workflows and frameworks/platforms such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Kubernetes or AWS/Azure equivalents.
Cloud or HPC exposure for large-scale simulation/data processing.
preferred_qualifications: Python is preferred; named packages are examples or permit equivalents, not independent mandatory mastery of every package. No separately labeled preferred-qualifications section.

software_and_programming_requirements.interpretation: Examples and equivalents retained; do not infer candidate product proficiency from custom implementations.

main_responsibilities: Lead customer engagements from discovery through deployment.
Integrate ML, ROMs, optimization and digital twins into scalable engineering workflows.
Develop solutions for ambiguous new use cases.
Collaborate with product development and influence capabilities.
Provide services, training, demonstrations and pre-sales support; mentor colleagues.

candidate_requirement_evidence.evidence: Dated UTSA research plus L&T and Rheem work spans more than five nonduplicated years of relevant simulation activity. The posting does not say whether all academic research counts; avoid equating that span to five industry years.
Python/CadQuery CAD generation and linked numerical/optimization workflows are documented. Commercial optiSLang/modeFrontier/HEEDS use is not established.

NASA MCVT coupled plant models, experimentally calibrated structural digital twin, and HVAC plant/SiL infrastructure provide direct evidence of model development and integration. Multi-fidelity commercial-tool delivery is only partly supported.
Completed neural-network damage surrogate trained on XFEM simulations directly supports engineering ML. The breadth and recent operational deployment expected at staff level are not established.
Modal-coordinate reduction and Guyan static condensation support reduced-order modeling. Explicit feature-engineering practice is not established.
Supercomputer-based coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian simulations are documented; cloud production platforms are not.
L&T client assignments and scientific communication are relevant; lead pre-sales, customer lifecycle deployment and commercial solution consulting are not established.

significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.detail: No documented PyTorch/TensorFlow/scikit-learn, Kubernetes or AWS/Azure delivery in the reviewed libraries; custom neural-network work is not equivalent proof.

Custom automation and coupled plant models are relevant equivalents in principle, but optiSLang/modeFrontier/HEEDS/Twin Builder/Simulink/AMESim proficiency and multi-fidelity production delivery need confirmation.

significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.requirement: Staff-level consultative leadership and customer adoption
significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.detail: Client assignments are documented; presales ownership, external training, deployment leadership and roadmap influence are not.

significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.requirement: Feature engineering and breadth of ML practice
significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.detail: XFEM neural-network surrogate is supported; broad regression/CNN/RNN/autoencoder work is not.

match_score_note: Heuristic suitability, not hiring probability. Strong physics/simulation/digital-twin foundation and preferred US remote location, reduced for commercial AI deployment and consulting gaps. This is a credible stretch application rather than a complete requirements match.
recommendation_reasons: Matches the top location preference: US remote.
Combines documented ROM, neural surrogate, digital-twin and automation experience.
Broad engineering degree and simulation experience requirements allow a relevant research background, subject to employer interpretation.

verification.active_page_evidence: Role-specific official page and Apply Now link present; also listed in employer simulation search.
verification.application_endpoint_status: Web fetch of Avature login returned 406; no application submitted and login flow not independently validated.
verification.closing_date: Use structured validThrough if supplied; otherwise not stated.
verification.availability_caveat: Posted in April; live listing is evidence of current advertising, not assurance of remaining open.
verification.duplicate_check: No matching company/requisition in existing jobs folders. Multiple index listings of 16469 treated as one role.

other_exclusions: Synopsys 18292: official job URL redirects to careers home; not verified open.
Rescale AI/ML simulation: multiple mandatory production frameworks not established.
Caterpillar rendering: graphics/GPU engine specialization not established.

candidate_source_notes: Candidate_profile.md references EXP-001_Rheem_Project_Engineer_II.md, which is absent in the current libraries root. Used EXP-001_Rheem_Project_Engineer_II_weighted_expanded.md as the current detailed Rheem source.
Used achievement text rather than weighted metadata as evidence; did not modify libraries.
